scope: Renderer-free real fixed-step solver; no browser, GPU, touch, or subjective playtest claim.

method.launch: Speed after 1 s and 2 s from rest under held throttle.
method.terminal: 40 s on a constant flat surface; compare actual speed with immutable nominal speed × surface speed factor.
method.braking: D/R interlock from a matched, previously verified attainable 1.5 m/s. Distance until velocity changes sign.
method.turn: Actual tire-generated angular acceleration at 1.5 m/s, steering 0.8, production grip-aware D rack angle, coasting.
method.slide: Released car enters at 1.5 m/s forward + 0.6 m/s sideways; measure lateral path until rest.
method.stability: 8 s held 0.8 steering in both gears, then 4 s straight recovery, then a brake-interlocked gear reversal.
method.grade: All 50 profiles face the maximum actual route grade as a conservative constant uphill, in both D and R.
method.timing: Identical input program at 30/60/120 Hz; 3 s stall compared against the existing 0.1 s / 12-substep budget.
